$comment: Every word the bot's commands reply with (ADR-0019). A {name} is filled only with a value bot_command.py has validated. .github/scripts/test_bot_command.py fails where a reply the script sends is missing here, or a reply here is never sent.
who: someone with write access to this repository, or this pull request's author

replies.closed: This pull request is closed, so `/{command}` changes nothing.
replies.update-asked: GitHub is merging `{base}` into this branch. It makes and signs the merge commit, and the squash merge leaves that commit out of `main`. A push by the bot's token needs a maintainer's approval before CI runs on the new head.
replies.rebase-is-update: GitHub cannot sign rebased commits, and `main` takes only signed ones, so `/rebase` merges `{base}` into this branch instead, as `/update` does.
replies.update-current: This branch already holds every commit of `{base}`.
replies.update-refused: GitHub could not merge `{base}` into this branch: the two conflict, or the branch moved while the bot read it. Merge `{base}` into your branch locally, resolve what conflicts, and push.
replies.update-forbidden: GitHub may not push to this branch. On a fork, tick *Allow edits by maintainers*, or merge `{base}` into your branch locally and push.
replies.retest-asked: Re-running the failed jobs of [the CI run]({run}) on this head, the re-run {attempt} of {limit}.
replies.retest-none: No CI run has started on this head yet.
replies.retest-waiting: [The CI run]({run}) on this head waits for a maintainer to approve it, and `/retest` re-runs only a run that has run.
replies.retest-running: [The CI run]({run}) on this head has not finished.
replies.retest-green: [The CI run]({run}) on this head has no failed job.
replies.retest-spent: [The CI run]({run}) on this head has been re-run {limit} times. Push a commit to run CI again, or ask a maintainer.
replies.docs-none: No heading of [the documentation]({docs}) matches what was asked.
replies.fix-committed: Committed the fix [the CI run]({run}) computed: {commit}.
replies.fix-nothing: [The CI run]({run}) on this head computed no fix.
replies.fix-fork: This branch is in a fork, which the bot cannot push to. Commit the suggested changes on the diff instead.
replies.fix-running: CI has not finished on this head, so there is no fix to commit yet.
replies.fix-refused: The fix [the CI run]({run}) computed cannot be committed: {why}. Run `{command}` locally and push.
replies.fix-moved: The branch moved while the bot read it. Comment `/fix` again on the new head.
replies.fix-protected: The bot commits only to a pull request's own branch, and this one is its base, the default branch, or a protected branch.
replies.fix-unmatched: The latest CI run on this head is not this pull request's own, so the bot commits nothing from it.
replies.why-not-in-diff: it changes a file this pull request does not
replies.why-too-large: it is larger than the bot commits
replies.why-stale: a hunk does not match this head, which the base has moved under
